title: Cindergale's Ash Cloud
story: Cindergale the Ash Roc circles the mountain village, beating soot from her wings until the sky goes grey. The villagers must ride the floating sky-baskets up to the clean air of Cloudledge before the ash settles. Mr 6 stands at the launch post, counting heads and doing arithmetic in the air with his sword-tip.
question: There are 143 villagers to lift, and each floating sky-basket safely holds 12 people. How many baskets must Mr 6 send up so that everyone gets out?
hint: Divide 143 by 12 and look at the leftover — those leftover people still need a basket of their own.
victory: The twelfth basket rose with just eleven passengers and one very smug six, and Cindergale, finding nobody left to frighten, flew off to shake her wings over an empty quarry. 'Nobody rides a leftover,' said Mr 6.
imagePrompt: A numeral-six knight directing frightened villagers into glowing wicker sky-baskets rising through swirling grey ash while an enormous soot-winged roc circles above a mountain village at dusk.
